plan: Model all patient-facing state in the public `session` dict with exactly the four contract keys, produced by a single `_fresh_session()` factory reused by construction, `begin`, and `abandon`.
Copy the `appointments` sequence into internal `{id, label}` dicts at construction so caller mutation cannot affect behavior, and re-copy per rendered screen.
Route `handle` through a string-keyed dispatch table of per-action methods; guard non-dict actions and non-string/unknown types up front so nothing raises.
Make every handler validate completely (open-session check, payload type check, known-id check) before mutating, guaranteeing invalid actions leave accepted data intact.

Centralize screen construction in `_screen(prompt, messages)`, which attaches appointment choices exactly when the prompt is `Choose appointment`; derive error and correction prompts from a `_next_prompt()` walk over unmet requirements.

Implement `run_once` against injected `action_source`/`screen_sink` ports, raising `RuntimeError` before either is used when one is missing, displaying the handled screen exactly once, and returning the same object so unittest fakes can assert identity.
mechanisms: String-keyed dispatch table mapping action types to validate-then-mutate handler methods
Single screen factory enforcing the choices-only-on-`Choose appointment` invariant
`_next_prompt()` derivation of the next unmet requirement, shared by corrections and error screens
`_fresh_session()` factory as the one definition of initial session shape
Defensive copying of appointment data at construction and per screen
Duck-typed source/sink injection (`read_action`/`display`) enabling standard-library unittest fakes
Precondition guard in `run_once` raising `RuntimeError` before any collaborator call
